question: What is the purpose of Lua 5.5’s `global *` chunk preamble?
options: It permits global variable declarations according to the chunk’s declaration rules; ordinary global names remain a distinct concern from locals
It creates all possible globals in advance
It means all Lua 5.1 programs are source-compatible
answer_key: It permits global variable declarations according to the chunk’s declaration rules; ordinary global names remain a distinct concern from locals
explanation: Lua 5.5 formalizes global declarations. Learn the chunk declaration rules and test migrated code; this syntax is not compatible with older Lua releases.
